    def _style_allowed(self):
        """Helper to check if 'style' is an allowed attribute for any tag"""
        if callable(self.attributes):
            # Can't determine if callable attributes allow style
            return False
        if isinstance(self.attributes, dict):
            # Check each tag's allowed attributes
            return any('style' in allowed_attrs for allowed_attrs in self.attributes.values())
        if isinstance(self.attributes, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
            # Check global allowed attributes
            return 'style' in self.attributes
        return False
